messages:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — AeroLex showing a pretty sharp usage drop starting Mon. Embeddings calls down ~68% week-over-week and token generation down ~40%. No error spikes, just lower volume.
Jamal: yikes. did this align with any known infra changes or billing alerts?
Elaine: Checked infra and billing — all green. No quota throttles. I pulled their last 30d active seat list and it’s stable.
Ravi: Was there a stakeholder change? sometimes usage drops after PM/ML swaps.
Elaine: Yep — their ML lead (Samir) left last month; now onboarding a new ML lead (Priya). I pinged Priya but haven’t heard back yet.
Elaine: Also saw a note in the account doc that they started a shorteval with CloudPrompt last week.
Priya: sorry for the slow reply — just joined AeroLex this week. FYI they paused a feature experiment that drove most of our calls while they re-evaluate prompts.
Jamal: ok so likely product decision + people change. still worried about renewal signal. Renewal in 8 weeks, right?
Elaine: renewal window opens in 55 days. Given usage and the eval with a competitor, I think this should be flagged as "at risk" and we should start a triage.
Ravi: agree. proposed next steps: 1) quick sync with new ML lead to unblock experiments 2) offer 2-week pilot credits for a cost-neutral comparison 3) enable a short DS pairing session to show perf/cost wins 4) track usage daily and escalate if no recovery in 7 days.
Elaine: I can own 1 & 3. Ravi — can you own the pilot credits and craft the offer? Jamal — can you run the usage daily checks and share a digest in this thread?
Ravi: I’ll draft the pilot offer. Suggest we give them a tailored quantization + prefix-caching config — usually recovers cost/perf quickly.
Jamal: will set up a daily scheduled query and post summary here at 9am PT. attaching the SQL I’ll use to detect recovery (if folks want to reuse):
```
-- daily active API calls and embeddings for AeroLex
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day,
  sum(case when category = 'embeddings' then 1 else 0 end) as embeddings_calls,
  sum(case when category = 'generation' then 1 else 0 end) as gen_calls
FROM metrics.events
WHERE customer_id = 'aerolex'
  AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day desc;
```
Priya: that SQL looks good. For the sync — can we aim for tomorrow 10am PT? I can pull the feature experiment notes beforehand.
Elaine: works for me. Ravi — can we include a short one-pager on the quantization/profile suggestion so Priya has something concrete?
Ravi: yes, I’ll attach a one-pager and a short code snippet for quick rollout.
Priya: thanks — if we can show comparable quality at 30–40% lower cost that’s a big win for our execs.
Elaine: action items recap:
- Elaine: schedule and run ML sync tomorrow 10am PT, collect experiment notes (owner: Elaine)
- Ravi: draft pilot credits offer + one-pager on quantization/profile (owner: Ravi)
- Jamal: daily usage digest starting tomorrow 9am PT (owner: Jamal)
- All: reconvene in this thread after 7 days or earlier if usage recovers (owner: Elaine)
OpsBot: Reminder — I created a playbook issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8721 (Renewal triage — AeroLex).
Jamal: added a quick risk tag to the account in SFDC (Renewal: At Risk) and linked the playbook ticket.
Elaine: I'll prep the customer-facing note and send post-sync. For now marking as priority playbook follow. :triage_tent: :spiral_calendar:
Priya: appreciate the quick coordination — I’ll push to unblock the paused experiment after our sync and report back.
Elaine: thanks team — feel free to drop any quick asks here. If we see no improvement in 7 days, I’ll propose an exec-level QBR invite.
